name: Hogwarts DB - Rust, SQLite, MongoDB & NASM Environment
postCreateCommand: set -e; sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y nasm curl gdb gcc-multilib gnupg ca-certificates; curl -fsSL https://pgp.mongodb.com/server-8.0.asc | sudo gpg --dearmor --yes -o /usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.gpg; echo "deb [ arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.gpg ] https://repo.mongodb.org/apt/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME)/mongodb-org/8.0 multiverse" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mongodb-org-8.0.list > /dev/null; sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y mongodb-org; sudo mkdir -p /data/db /var/log/mongodb; sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /data/db /var/log/mongodb; printf '.mode table\n.headers on\n' > ~/.sqliterc; sqlite3 hogwarts.db < setup.sql
